services.desc: The cost of live bait is reimbursable after the trip at current bait shop prices. We also offer Flounder gigging trips, Bull Red, Black Drum, Shark, and night fishing trips, as well as Sunset/Booze Cruises out of Galveston & Clear Lake. Call for more details. Luxury bay boat, rods, reels, all tackle and artificial lures, ice, bottled water, photos and your fish cleaned and bagged for the ride home. Texas Fishing license with saltwater stamp, proper seasonal attire, hat, sunglasses, sunscreen, mosquito spray, wading gear if wading, boat shoes, ice chest to take your fish home and whatever you'd like to eat and drink for the day.
